About Fibox 

At Fibox Group, we take pride in being one of the largest enclosure manufacturers in the world. ​For us, an enclosure is not just an enclosure. In our perspective, it is an innovative way of encapsulating and ​protecting valuable equipment one may have invested in developing, installing, or acquiring.

INTRODUCING

The ARCA JIC

Fibox´s new ARCA non-metallic enclosures provide users of classic electrical junction boxes an easy upgrade path to a high performance enclosure featuring 21st century technology. Precision, injection molded, ARCA enclosures feature superior chemical resistance and the wide temperature utilization range of polycarbonate plastic. Available in classic sizes, these enclosures feature industry standard dimensions and panels.

Why choose Fibox?

Fibox combines deep engineering expertise with a strong global footprint to help customers protect and optimize critical systems. Our focus is long-term performance, ensuring safety, efficiency, and trust in every solution we deliver.

1. Global leader in enclosure and protection solutions

Fibox is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of thermoplastic enclosures, protecting electrical and electronic components in even the most demanding and hazardous environments.

2. Complete solutions from design to delivery

Fibox provides high-quality electrical and automation systems along with end-to-end services, including concept design, customized solutions, prototyping, and manufacturing.

3. Trusted innovation with decades of expertise

With nearly 60 years of experience and a pioneering role in modular polycarbonate enclosures, Fibox combines Nordic design with continuous innovation and global technical leadership.
